title: The First Voyage
summary: Columbus sails west from Spain to reach Asia, sure it lies a few weeks away. He finds islands no European chart holds, and calls the people who live there Indians.

title: Around the World
explorer: Ferdinand Magellan and Juan Sebastián Elcano
summary: Five ships sail west to reach the Spice Islands by a strait no one has found, across an ocean no one guessed was so wide. Three years later one ship comes home with eighteen of the 260 or so who left.

title: The Endeavour
summary: Sent to Tahiti to watch Venus cross the sun, then south to find a continent that was not there. Cook charts the coasts of New Zealand and eastern Australia instead, with the navigator Tupaia aboard.

title: The Corps of Discovery
summary: Up the Missouri, over the Rockies and down the Columbia to the Pacific, looking for a water route across the continent. There was none, and they survived on the help of the nations whose lands they crossed.

title: The South Pole
summary: Five Norwegians with dogs and skis race a British expedition to the last great blank on the map. They find a new way up through the mountains and reach the Pole on 14 December 1911.
